label: human-20
people: [gecko]thebluegecko (lobby 41), Armada, the opponent; no spectator spoke; chat was 'gl hf!' both ways
our_side: seat 0 (one record), Armada vehicles from G1 (his start B5, plant B4); player Opus 5.5 medium (46 turns, 12.3 s wall median) under an Opus 5.5 high commander seat (8 turns, 6 directions, the chat); hands Jev on the rebuilt one-menu hands with layers (2026-10-02); the standing brief
summary: We built an army above the pool's p75 by 3:00 (722) and 4:00 (1,021), but the first Blitzes were made a picket against his Rovers and split into hunts of one or two that caught nothing, so the 3:00-4:00 lead of 4.9-14.7x (of what we saw) never left G2/F2. thebluegecko opened Rovers that killed our first lone constructor and the F1/H2/H3 extractors, then massed Blitzes and raided in parties of 3-9 while our eight-Blitz body held, chased one raider home (4:18-4:45) and another west (5:20-5:54) under packets and directions that said to cross. It crossed at 6:02, strung out, and lost 8 Blitzes for 4 at D3; after that the army was 0.8-1.0x and the extractors 3-6 against the pool's 13-17. The plant died at 8:02, the player turned to Stouts and Sentries at home, and 15-23 of his Blitzes ended it at 11:11 with no building of his ever killed.

their_play: Armada vehicles, plant at B4 (spot_36), a Sentry at spot_19 (B3) and at spot_50 (B5), at least seven extractors seen by 5:00 (spot_28, 19, 36, 45, 50, 43, 52). He opened Rovers that crossed to our F1 side by 2:44, killed the lone constructor at 2:55 and spot_3, spot_17, spot_25 (2:46-4:18) and outran every Blitz hunt. From about 4:14 he raided with Blitzes, one alone killing both home extractors at 4:41-4:44, then parties of 3-6 at F1/F2 (5:22-5:43), met our crossing at D3 with six and won 8 for 4 (6:04-6:23), and raided our home with 6-9 at a time (6:55, the plant at 8:02, 8:46-9:20) before closing with 15-23 at 10:16-11:11. Of his 5,590 lost (what we saw), 4,397 died at our base and 440 in his half: he fought only on our side and kept expanding. No tier 2 in 11 minutes.

bears_on.note: Our Rovers crossed at 2:22 and found his plant at 2:46, but no Blitz crossed until 6:02 and no building of his died in 11:11 while he expanded to seven seen extractors by 5:00 and raided freely.

bears_on.id: The raid answer: who answers a raider, pickets, the turret with the spot, the 600 rule

A person's Rover opening paid (the lone constructor at 2:55, three extractors by 4:18) where our Blitz hunts paid nothing: the micro the lesson says the units need.
Extractors 3-6 all game against the pool's 7/13/17 at 4/6/8 minutes; the player's 10:56 note: 'the economy never recovered after 4:54'.
Three solars with a constructor as the plant's first unit (1:23, the pool's first constructor 1:30); the plant at 1:04 and first soldier 1:35 against 0:34 and 0:55.
The commander assisted the plant 114 s of the first 4:00 (floor assist4; pool 50); the commander seat's 3:05 direction told it off the plant 'while metal is at 0', against the lesson.

tools: inline python over strategist-0.jsonl (instruct texts), commander.jsonl (directions, notes) and record-0.jsonl (destroyed)
lens.caveats: No truth file: his numbers are floors of what we saw. No results.jsonl (analyze_match and floor print 'outcome None after 0.0 min'); the result is the ledger's. pro_baseline has no G1 Armada card; --all-starts used, pressure rows blank for ours. No computer_whisperer line in this game's chat; the only people's words are the lessons. I agree with review.md's root and chain and differ on: (1) the 2:44 picket followed the role text's own picket sentence, so the owner is the brief and the player; (2) three solars is within L-opening-solar-cap and fits L-opening-solars, and the opening is off the chain (army >p75 at 3:00-4:00); (3) the 5:54 F-column lists predate the 6:05 direction; (4) 'his Blitzes won every even fight' (the commander seat's note, a model's) holds only at D3: home fights were near even (720/660, 1135/990, 1795/1870).

open_questions: Were the two Rovers recorded as killed by armcv at B4 (2:57, 3:09) reclaimed by his constructors, killed by his commander, or given a wrong attacker?
Did group_L hold 7:50-8:02 while party_17 killed the plant under the packet's 'outweighs' clause or because the hands posed no answer (party_17 answer read 0.83)?
party_11 was 3 Blitzes at spot_3 (F1) at 5:20 and 6 at D3 at 6:07: the same party grown, or a name passed (H-HANDS-PARTY-NAME-STAYS was built after human-21)?
With a Sentry at spot_3/spot_11 by 2:00 and the 2:28 words kept, would four Blitzes in his half by 3:00 have survived his Rovers and the B3/B5 Sentries? No truth file to price his economy.
